title: Allpole Filter
text: 全极点滤波器建模，输入 2 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Integer rounding mode} 指定整数舍入模式；{Coefficient source} 指定系数来源、{Filter structure} 指定滤波器结构 Direct、{Coefficients} 指定滤波器分母系数、{Input processing} 指定输入处理 Columns as channels、{Initial states} 指定滤波器状态的初始条件、{Coefficients Minimum} 指定滤波器系数的最小值、{Coefficients Maximum} 指定滤波器系数的最大值、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Accumulator} 指定累加器数据类型、{State} 指定状态数据类型、{Output} 输出数据类型、{Output Minimum} 输出最小值、{Output Maximum} 输出最大值、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和，按实例取值。

ports.name: Den
ports.summary: 滤波器分母系数 scalar | row vector

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: 系数来源 Dialog parameters (default) | Input port

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: 指定滤波器结构 Direct form (default) | Direct form transposed | Lattice AR

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: 滤波器分母系数 [1 0.1] (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 输入处理 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Initial states
params.values: 滤波器状态的初始条件 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Coefficients Minimum
params.values: 滤波器系数的最小值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Coefficients Maximum
params.values: 滤波器系数的最大值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: State
params.values: 状态数据类型 Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as input (default) | Inherit: Same as accumulator | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: 整数舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和 off (default) | on
